design: Average-height heavy adult female Yautja guard with russet speckled hide, strong wide exposed four-mandibled face, round domed cranium with small ivory brow ridges, short dreadlocks with two longer strands framing face. Thick square dark plate armor with bronze corners, reinforced wrap collar, small round shoulder discs, short heavy layered leather skirt, thick bootlike shin armor exposing clawed toes. A compact non-firing alien stun carbine hangs safely muzzle down from a chest sling and she loosely holds its grip, free hand rests beside belt. Relaxed sentry stance.
